cards.title: Introduction to Authentication
cards.content: Authentication is the process of verifying who a user is, while authorization determines what they can do. In ASP.NET Core, the authentication system is handled by the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication package, which relies on registered handlers.

cards.title: Configuring JWT Bearer
cards.content:
To enable JWT authentication in ASP.NET Core, configure the services in Program.cs:

builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options => {
        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters {
            ValidateIssuer = true,
            ValidateAudience = true,
            ValidateLifetime = true,
            ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true
        };
    });
